propositions: The outbound comment dedup key is computed by the differ using a different composition than the send path uses, causing key predictions to drift from actual sent bytes when fit/encode steps diverge.

The differ must derive the dedup key from the exact wire bytes sent rather than predicting them, eliminating the convergence obligation for three separately-maintained fit compositions to stay in lockstep.

Both mutation-enactment consumers (create path in dispatch_one.py and update path in dispatch_apply_phases.py) must read and send the fitted wire_body from the mutation entry, with fallback to unfitted body for pre-cutover entries.
The adapter's defensive fit must be idempotent: re-fitting an already-fitted body must return it byte-identical so the key cannot be moved after it is taken.
The fit_for_send function must return both landed_text (the decoded readback for keying) and wire_body (the pre-encode fitted text for sending) as a single FittedComment struct.
